name: io.github.junichi-takeda/capture-screen
description: Windows screen capture MCP server with display/window/region capture tools and capture cleanup tools.

environment_variables.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_DEFAULT_DISPLAY
environment_variables.description: Default display selector when capture_display display argument is omitted. Values: primary,left,right,プライマリ,左,右 or monitor index.

environment_variables.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_OUTPUT_DIR
environment_variables.description: Default output directory for PNG captures. Default is C:\capture_screen.

environment_variables.name: CAPTURE_SCREEN_HIDE_FOREGROUND_WINDOWS_TERMINAL
environment_variables.description: Set 0/false/off to disable temporary hiding of overlapping Windows Terminal windows during capture_screen/capture_display/capture_region.
